# Rancher's Food

> Rancher's Food (Premium Meat) is a Cairo, Egypt–based premium meat supplier serving restaurants, hotels and food industries with beef, lamb, veal cuts and the Miko brand of processed meats.

## Company
- Name: Rancher's Food (also: Premium Meat)
- Country: Egypt
- Headquarters: Plot No. 29, Small Industries Area, North Katameya Road, Ain Sokhna — Third Settlement, New Cairo, Cairo, Egypt
- Website: https://www.ranchersfood.com
- Email: Info@ranchersfood.com
- Phone: +20 2 2572 8727, +20 109 300 0166
- Tagline: For food industries

## Product categories

### Beef cuts (Steaks & Fillet)
- Rib-Eye Steak — well-marbled, from the longitudinal back muscles; "The King" of steaks.
- T-Bone Steak — cut from the lower back, attached to the vertebrae; distinctive flavour.
- Roast Beef — slow-cooked, lean yet succulent, balanced tenderness and depth.
- Sirloin Cap — from the upper leg; collagen between fibres yields a gelatinous, textured bite.
- Fillet — leanest and most tender cut; virtually fat-free, melts in the mouth.
- Short Rib — bone-in chuck; rewards long, slow cooking.
- Brisket — well-marbled breast cut; low-and-slow cooking yields juicy texture.
- Tomahawk Steak — rib-eye on the long rib bone; quality plus visual impact.

### Lamb cuts
- Spring Lamb — low-fat, delicate flavour, pinkish colour.
- Lamb Shoulder — tender, rich and savoury; ideal for slow roasts and grills.
- Lamb Leg — hind cut; classic for kebabs.
- Lamb Shank / Mousa (top of leg) — natural gelatin enhances tenderness.

### Veal cuts
- Veal Kebab — tender cubed leg/back; low fat, fast cooking.
- Veal Shank — bone-in with marrow; rewards slow cooking.
- Osso Buco (with bone) — cross-cut leg with central marrow; deep, luxurious flavour.
- Veal Ribs — bone-in rib with tender meat and just enough fat.

### Miko processed meats (ready-to-cook)
- Miko Beef Burger — pure beef from finest cuts with authentic natural flavours.
- Miko Kofta — premium fresh meat with balanced seasoning.
- Miko Oriental Sausage — fresh meat with distinctive oriental seasoning.
- Miko Marinated Liver — fresh liver slices in a balanced oriental marinade.
- Miko Tarab — seasoned kofta wrapped in lamb caul fat; smoky and rich.
- Miko Hawawshi — stuffed with seasoned meat and Egyptian spices.
- Miko Minced Meat — pure meat, finely minced; recipe-ready base.
- Miko Cheeseburger — premium beef topped with melted cheese.

## Audience
- B2B: restaurants, hotels, catering, food processors and food industries.
- Region served: Egypt.
